DELETE FROM OM.OM_TASK_RUN WHERE TASK_NAME LIKE '%CCD_CUSTOMER%'


select SCD_START_DATE SCD_START_DATE_2, SCD_END_DATE SCD_END_DATE_2,FILE_NAME FILE_NAME_2,* from (
SELECT * FROM
EDS.CCD_CUSTOMER WHERE CUST_NBR='000000000004050'
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM
EDS.CCD_CUSTOMER WHERE CUST_NBR='000000000004058'
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM
EDS.CCD_CUSTOMER WHERE CUST_NBR='000000000004062'
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM
EDS.CCD_CUSTOMER WHERE CUST_NBR='99999999' ) temp order by CUST_NBR, SCD_START_DATE
